The [[Jade Brotherhood]] are gathering a large army, you must stop them before it gets out of hand!

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Find the Jade Brotherhood in [[Bukdek Byway]] and eliminate them.
* See Guardsman Chienpo for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 175 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
If you have access to it, the easiest way to complete this is to start from [[Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter)]]. Otherwise exit from [[The Marketplace]] and head east. When you attack [[Kenshi Steelhand]] a small group of Jade Brotherhood will spawn to help him.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Guardsman Chienpo
:''"I have come into possession of some reliable and disturbing information. The '''Jade Brotherhood''' is gathering in large numbers in '''Bukdek Byway''' to confront the Am Fah. Such a brawl can only mean disaster for the good citizens of Cantha. The city guard does not have the resources to deal with this threat, but perhaps you would be willing to handle this matter?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Leave it to me.
|decline = Doesn't YOUR name begin with Guardsman?  This sounds like a job for you, not me.
|ask = Stop the '''Jade Brotherhood''' from gathering in '''Bukdek Byway'''. 
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Guardsman Chienpo
:''"The city guard is forever in your debt."''

==Notes==
*[[Kenshi Steelhand]] spawns twice during this quest. Once in his usual location and once in the quest location.
*The counterpart to this quest is [[Eliminate the Am Fah]].
